notice: Timestamped public build snapshot used only when live upstream coverage is unavailable. Every fallback record remains visibly labelled and linked to its original public source.

records.title: Iran and US make competing claims over control of the Strait of Hormuz
records.summary: Iranian and U.S. officials made conflicting public claims over control and transit conditions in the Strait of Hormuz amid continuing military and shipping tensions.

records.title: Gulf markets ease as U.S.-Iran tensions and Hormuz disruption weigh
records.summary: Gulf equities traded cautiously while shipping disruption and U.S.-Iran tensions continued to affect regional risk pricing; Brent was reported near $87.82.

records.title: Taiwan conducts anti-blockade naval drill during Han Kuang exercises
records.summary: Taiwan carried out an anti-blockade exercise involving navy and coast guard units while civil-defence drills also tested wartime resilience and degraded communications.

records.title: Taiwan reports AI-assisted hacking campaign against government agencies
records.summary: Taiwan said it detected an AI-assisted overseas cyber campaign targeting government agencies; authorities said affected bodies handled the incident.

records.title: Ukrainian drone attack shuts Russia Orsk refinery, governor says
records.summary: A strike forced the Orsk refinery to shut, with local authorities warning repairs could take months and fuel supply would need support from outside the region.

records.title: Russia attacks Ukraine Danube port of Izmail
records.summary: Russian strikes damaged port infrastructure and power around Izmail; the Danube export route remains important for Ukrainian grain and regional logistics.

records.title: Hapag-Lloyd reports $600 million hit from Middle East shipping crisis
records.summary: The container carrier reported a major quarterly financial impact from Middle East disruption and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

records.title: India trade deficit hits six-month high as imports rise amid Middle East conflict
records.summary: India reported a $31.98 billion merchandise deficit as imports rose; exporters also faced higher freight rates, container shortages and shipping delays.

records.title: Yen post-intervention gains hinge on Bank of Japan rate expectations
records.summary: Markets focused on whether the Bank of Japan will tighten policy after coordinated intervention temporarily strengthened the yen.

records.title: Putin visits disputed Kuril island, drawing protest from Japan
records.summary: The Russian president visited Iturup/Etorofu, prompting condemnation from Tokyo and adding to Russia-Japan political and security friction.

records.title: Canada unhappy with latest U.S. tariff offer, CBC reports
records.summary: Canada was reported to be dissatisfied with the latest U.S. tariff proposal, keeping North American trade-policy risk in focus.

records.title: Global stocks rise as oil falls below $90 and Iran remains in focus
records.summary: Global equities advanced while oil prices fell and investors reassessed U.S. rate expectations; Iran and Hormuz remained major macro risk factors.

records.title: Dollar steadies after benign U.S. inflation reduces Fed hike bets
records.summary: Traders reduced the implied chance of a September Federal Reserve rate increase after U.S. inflation data came in benign.

records.title: IEA sees deeper 2026 oil supply shortfall while Hormuz reopening remains elusive
records.summary: The IEA cut its 2026 supply outlook and projected a large third-quarter deficit as Middle East output and Hormuz transit remained disrupted.
